title: Structured error classification — typed error events for SSE stream
description: Add error classification to responses.js that distinguishes recoverable errors (rate-limit, timeout) from non-recoverable errors (schema violation, auth failure). Emit typed error events on the SSE stream so the frontend can auto-retry recoverable errors and show error cards for non-recoverable ones.
action: In responses.js, add ERROR_CLASSES map: { rate_limit: {recoverable: true, retry_after: 30}, timeout: {recoverable: true, retry_after: 5}, schema_violation: {recoverable: false}, auth_failure: {recoverable: false}, model_error: {recoverable: true, retry_after: 10}, unknown: {recoverable: false} }. Add buildStructuredErrorEvent(errorClass, message, diagnostics) that produces {type:'error', error_class, recoverable, retry_after, message, diagnostics}. In flow-control.js, classify errors before emitting events.

convergence.verification: Call buildStructuredErrorEvent('rate_limit', 'Too many requests', {}) and verify output has {error_class: 'rate_limit', recoverable: true, retry_after: 30}
convergence.definition_of_done: SSE error events include typed error_class and recoverable flag that frontend can route to auto-retry or error card

files.change: Add ERROR_CLASSES constant map with 6 error types and their recoverable/retry_after properties. Add buildStructuredErrorEvent(errorClass, message, diagnostics) function returning {type:'error', error_class, recoverable, retry_after, message, diagnostics, timestamp}
Add classifyError(error) function that maps error.message/status to ERROR_CLASSES key. Replace raw error emission with buildStructuredErrorEvent()

implementation: In responses.js, add const ERROR_CLASSES = { rate_limit: {recoverable:true, retry_after:30}, timeout: {recoverable:true, retry_after:5}, schema_violation: {recoverable:false}, auth_failure: {recoverable:false}, model_error: {recoverable:true, retry_after:10}, unknown: {recoverable:false} }
In responses.js, add function buildStructuredErrorEvent(errorClass, message, diagnostics) that looks up ERROR_CLASSES[errorClass] || ERROR_CLASSES.unknown and returns structured error object

In flow-control.js, add function classifyError(error) that checks error.status (429→rate_limit, 401/403→auth_failure, 408→timeout) and error.message patterns (schema→schema_violation, model→model_error) with fallback to 'unknown'
In flow-control.js step execution error path, replace raw error object with classifyError(error) → buildStructuredErrorEvent(result, error.message, error.diagnostics)

reference.pattern: responses.js builds all SSE event shapes — new builders follow same pattern as buildWorkflowErrorResponse

rationale.chosen_approach: Error classification at the engine level ensures all frontend consumers get consistent error types without re-parsing messages
decision_factors: Backward compatible — error_class field is additive
Centralized classification avoids per-hook error parsing
